generatedFrom: 2026-08-19, one-tap WhatsApp send. Five ceilings raised and four lowered in one pass, which needs explaining because the rule here is that ceilings only ratchet down. The feature's own code is not what moved them: every share surface loads the sheet through next/dynamic, and /protected/dashboard -- which grew most, +1947 -- contains none of it (grep its chunks). Adding one more consumer of ui/sheet and ui/dropdown-menu tipped webpack's splitChunks threshold, so both were hoisted OUT of per-route chunks and INTO the shared app/protected layout chunk (53,801 -> 59,798 raw). fee-setup, payments, exports and admin-tools each shed ~735 bytes and are ratcheted down accordingly; dashboard, students, transactions, defaulters and receipts each gained ~1.3-2.0 KB because this gate counts that shared layout chunk once per route. A browser downloads it once, so the real cost is roughly its +1947 gzip per session, not the +5,865 the per-route sum implies. `shared` rootMainFiles is unchanged within noise (129,260 -> 129,335) and its ceiling is untouched. Ceilings carry ~1.5% headroom over the measured figure, as they always have -- a ceiling pinned to the exact measurement fails on the next build, because consecutive builds of identical source differ by 20-40 bytes.
